title: Explain held relay queue heads and their effect on unrelated automatic work
outcome: An idle root whose relay carrier is held exposes an actionable reason instead of appearing silently stuck; automatic bypass remains subject to an explicit product decision.
acceptance: Held relay head status explains disable/revoke/unavailable metadata without claiming delivery or empty history.
Controls preserve relay authority/Stop/retained-preparation boundaries; any automatic-work bypass expansion has separately recorded product authority.
